title: unread_ids_from_loaded_messages: VecDeque index instead of zip is a panic footgun
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:575: the function indexes into ids via ids[i] while iterating senders with enumerate. If the two VecDeques ever have different lengths (invariant violation), this panics at runtime with an opaque index-out-of-bounds. Suggested rewrite: senders.iter().zip(ids.iter()).filter(|(s,_)| s.as_str() != 'self').map(|(_,id)| id.clone()).filter(|id| !id.is_empty()).collect(). zip silently stops at the shorter deque rather than panicking.
